TERBI is a U.S. outdoor living brand creating thoughtfully engineered structures for modern backyards.

We believe the space outside a home deserves the same level of thought as the space inside it: thoughtful design, lasting quality, easier ownership and practical support that continues after purchase.
Part of the home. Part of your life.

Backyards are not leftover space. They are where tools get organized, families gather, projects happen, plants grow and weekends slow down.

TERBI approaches outdoor structures as part of the home, not as objects placed beside it. We consider how a product looks in the landscape, how it handles everyday use, how clearly it goes together and how well it continues to work over time.

Because better outdoor space is not about adding more things. It is about making the space you already have work better.
Take a look behind the scenes of our latest product launch.

At TERBI, design begins with the space, not the product alone.

We study proportion, architecture, landscape, movement and everyday use before resolving structure, materials and details. The goal is to create outdoor structures that feel considered from the first sketch to the finished backyard.
One Brand. More Ways to Live Outdoors.
TERBI brings multiple outdoor needs into one brand.
Storage buildings that make outdoor time more comfortable and usable.
Spaces and products that support gardening and seasonal use.
Outdoor settings designed around cooking, relaxing and time together.
Structures that help protect vehicles, equipment and everyday assets.
Thoughtful by Design. Built for What's Next.
One brand system across storage, living, gardening, entertaining and protection.

TERBI INC. is a U.S. company building a long-term outdoor living brand around one idea: better outdoor space should be better designed, easier to own and built for real life.

Our point of view is shaped by the way modern households use backyards, patios, gardens, garages and outdoor gathering spaces, with equal attention to how products look, work and live over time.
Better space is not about having more. It is about making what you have work better.
Explore sheds and storage cabinets designed for backyards, patios, tools, and everyday outdoor organization.
